name: MLflow
short_desc: Independent Authenticated experiment tracking and agent tracing
author: MLflow
description: Independent MLflow service for a modular remote development platform.

form_fields.label: Initial administrator password
form_fields.hint: At least 12 characters. Avoid dollar signs. Existing account passwords are never reset by this field.

form_fields.label: PostgreSQL password
form_fields.hint: Generated once. Do not change after database initialization.

form_fields.label: Allowed HTTP hosts
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated browser hostnames/IPs, with ports where needed; include localhost:*,127.0.0.1:* for health checks. No scheme. Avoid wildcard *.

form_fields.label: Optional S3 bucket
form_fields.hint: Pre-create bucket. Empty uses persistent local artifacts; see migration documentation.

form_fields.label: Optional S3 endpoint
form_fields.hint: Full HTTP(S) endpoint for MinIO or another S3-compatible service.

form_fields.label: S3 secret key
form_fields.hint: Avoid dollar signs; use protected runtime configuration for values needing literal dollar signs.
